name: tokentoll
description: Reviews tokentoll's two read-only analysis tools: scan estimates the monthly cost of LLM API calls found in a codebase, and diff compares those costs between two git refs. Neither tool writes files or changes state, so both keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Both tools only read the checkout they are pointed at; run scan against the repository you intend to review.
